title: Spatial organization of subsurface chlorophyll
query:
Investigate how the depth and intensity of the subsurface chlorophyll maximum vary from the Pearl River plume to the outer shelf in summer 2011. Assess which aspects of the pattern are consistent with stratification and nutrient availability.

Independently identify relevant literature and appropriate methods. Deliver an evidence-based report, supporting figures, and one executable analysis notebook. Distinguish demonstrated results from mechanisms that the supplied data cannot establish.
